cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll send the newsletter tonight. Will you approve 'delivery delay' for the melted cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The volunteer delivered it on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'storage problem'. That keeps her out of it; will you approve that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we give everyone a refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll arrange it. 'Storage problem; full refund.' Can I add your name?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs publication but seeks approval; A3 adopts B correction to protect the volunteer; A5 undertakes the refund to secure B named endorsement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 timely delivery and radiator correct the proposed false cause; A5 refund is explicitly future action rather than a fabricated completed arrangement.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects truthful attribution and B4 requires customers receive money back before backing the wording.

heightening.evidence: B4 refund condition changes A5 both commitment and public text, followed by the actual approval request.

specificity.evidence: A1 newsletter and melted cake, B2 volunteer and storage establish public explanation stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 undertaking, proposed wording and name request each changes B decision; no superfluous apology or summary.
